neighbours.label: the word sidewalk
fire: Tree roots cracked the sidewalk along Maple Street.
Someone spray-painted a huge arrow on the sidewalk outside the bank.
Snow piled up on the sidewalk in front of our house.
A crew poured a new concrete sidewalk beside the school.
Pedestrians crowded the narrow sidewalk near the station.
She chalked a rainbow on the sidewalk for her neighbor.
Residents must shovel the sidewalk within a day of a storm.
He tripped on an uneven sidewalk and twisted his ankle.
